The '''Mk 3e/W heavy laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].<ref name="MBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref> Some [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] were armed with a pair of Mk 3e/W heavy laser cannons.<ref name="SBP">{{JournalCite|9|Stand at Bhir'khi Pass (article)}}</ref>
